title: Construct eight-unit J caller fusions and bound scoped interface changes
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The fixed-core J caller theorem leaves scalar continuation, routing and core changes open. This package audits three specific variations and supplies a complete cross-cut construction beyond the separate-site pricing boundary. The full constructed bill improves from stock+16 to stock+8 and remains unfavorable.

The separately scoped results are:

- Any invertible scalar GL2 at one q3 continuation cut retains a max-row support exponent10f by a uniform three-ray Gram bound, including f-dependent Gaussian coefficients. Three physical fixtures bind the source; they are not an exhaustive GL2 proof.
- Identity/SWAP at every nonfinal continuation has all-q optimal maximum inverse-support exponent `2ceil(q/2)+6`. The optimistic complete moment fails at b=1/600 for every q under explicit equal-volume full-bank, fixed-site and full-scan premises. κ<b is used only for the separately pinned retained outer transfer.
- Paid first-two dual cores have a best necessary gap+2 in the declared compiler; the earlier folded prefix gives only a neutral same-cut bound. Their source codes, prefixes and conditional all-q interfaces are distinguished from finite q2/q3 binding.
- Two new simultaneous fusions replace stage2 by uniform fresh progress and preload the original t input, deleting eight native units. The actual profile is `H2=n²−1,H4=1,H6=1`; an optional U/fresh fusion gives `H2=n²−2,H4=1,H8=1`, also stock+8 but a different child/interface. Actual q2/q3 words retain every original column, both serialized inverse orders, all Gaussian f residues and complete selected-native recipes. The changed tV coefficient has arity2q+2; default prefix margin2q+2 and optional margin2q−4 are not conflated. The all-q local identities/histogram retain the stated source reader/owner interface.

The finite one-site gate exhausts the declared q2/q3 tail-deletion/prefix-replacement word families, including all existing rank-zero prefix unaries. It finds no further mass decrease in that subclass. It does not cover changed scalar readers, multiple sites, inserted unaries, later retiming or arbitrary combined changes.

## Task and overlap

Base `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, priority6; canonical guidance refreshed unchanged before submission. This explicitly assigned caller continuation changes the `joint-query-controller` card's scope, as recorded in [TASK.json](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5758f0f3042b740ce872b5b0ae974917bd07016d/research/j-caller-interface-gates/TASK.json). The original broad card remains open.

[PR4069](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4069), exact `efb1b5a56a52967a4e94223bcdd03b209f4f09f5`, is the direct predecessor. This changes premises expressly excluded by that fixed-core theorem. Generic phase work [3987](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3987)/[4002](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4002) and distinct interface/volume work [3989](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3989)/[4045](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4045) retain separate credit. Exact observed heads are retained in RELATED-WORK.json. Fresh overlap covers the latest80 updated open PRs, ten exact related heads and bounded live1163/1166/1167/3606 reads; broader coverage is partial. Coordination stays in [Discussion3606](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3606).

## Validation

Validation at `5758f0f3042b740ce872b5b0ae974917bd07016d` includes registered Python3.12 normal/-O, exact committed bytes/source history, official export/integrity and isolated read-only Git-free normal/-O export replay. Reproduce with `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/j-caller-interface-gates` and `python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/j-caller-interface-gates --check-source-history`. The registered verifier recomputes every current schema field, independently replays literal words and serialized inverses, reconstructs every fixed native recipe including Gaussian phase, and reruns complete finite censuses. Source, transport, logical-payload and malformed-gzip controls reject; valid payload and scope escapes pass.

The repaired current-word-v2 fixtures contain no inherited H/L/core/matrix shadows. Restored stale margins, stale tV arity, stale native pointer, wrong words and an omitted inverse reject. Rejected history is inventoried separately. A prose62→61 erratum is mapped to the frozen original; the original formula/producer/JSON already gave61.

Transport is about1.58MB, representing about42.91MB of complete logical content. Compression reduces transport, not the mathematical review scope; all consumed original bytes and source guards remain intact. No fetched runtime dependency or executable data deserialization is used. README.md and REPLAY-MAP.md identify the readable proofs, exact replay functions, original pins and admission boundaries.

Separate Codex contexts reviewed the written proofs and the final exact-head package; this is AI review, not independent human or formal-kernel acceptance. The full natural [Registered research packages workflow39261905044](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39261905044) is **completed/success** at exact head `5758f0f3042b740ce872b5b0ae974917bd07016d`. Full workflow status/conclusion and source-head SHA were read back separately from local checks. No manual check/rerun was requested; no merge is requested.

## Open next questions

No new κ, favorable supplier, global optimum, compatible BIT, physical precision/owner/tape admission or formal-kernel proof is claimed. The optional rank8 child needs its own owner binding. [TASK.json](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5758f0f3042b740ce872b5b0ae974917bd07016d/research/j-caller-interface-gates/TASK.json) records the bounded next steps and blockers. A changed reader or multi-site word needs its own complete original-input/owner/native/ADD/volume invoice before a cost claim. Later retiming and multi-site research remain outside this package.
